response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS patient_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS patient_ana FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_acl_igg) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(patient_ana) AS avg_ana FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM sex_averages) AS ana_ratio FROM sex_averages
